facts.claim: [Station: Milan (MILANO), Italy; city station, not on Lake Como] WMO World Weather Information Service, data supplied by the Italian Air Force Department of Meteorology, climatological information based on monthly averages for the 30-year period 1971-2000: November mean daily minimum 3.7 C, mean daily maximum 10.7 C, mean total rainfall 76.7 mm, mean number of rain days 6.4. The page does not define a rain day for this station.

[Station: Naples (NAPOLI), Italy; city station, not on the Amalfi Coast itself] WMO World Weather Information Service, data supplied by the Italian Air Force Department of Meteorology, 30-year period 1971-2000: November mean daily minimum 7.8 C, mean daily maximum 17.1 C, mean total rainfall 152.1 mm, mean number of rain days 10.2. The page does not define a rain day for this station. On the same table November has the highest mean rainfall of any month (next highest October 135.5 mm).

[Station: Nice, France] WMO World Weather Information Service, data supplied by Meteo-France, 30-year period 1971-2000: November mean daily minimum 8.8 C, mean daily maximum 16.3 C, mean total precipitation 94.3 mm, mean number of precipitation days 6.6. The page defines a precipitation day as a day with at least 1 mm of precipitation, and states precipitation includes both rain and snow.

[Station: Lisboa (Lisbon), Portugal] WMO World Weather Information Service, data supplied by Instituto Portugues do Mar e da Atmosfera (IPMA), 30-year period 1961-1990: November mean daily minimum 11.2 C, mean daily maximum 17.8 C, mean total rainfall 113.5 mm, mean number of rain days 14.0. The page defines a rain day as a day with at least 0.1 mm of rain.

[Station: Port Louis, Mauritius] WMO World Weather Information Service, data supplied by Mauritius Meteorological Services, 30-year period 1971-2000: November mean daily minimum 21.8 C, mean daily maximum 30.2 C, mean total precipitation 24.0 mm, mean number of precipitation days 3.0. The page defines a precipitation day as a day with at least 1 mm of precipitation. Port Louis is one station on the north-west coast; the page gives no figures for other parts of the island.

[Station: Victoria, Seychelles (Mahe)] WMO World Weather Information Service, data supplied by Seychelles Meteorological Authority, 30-year period 1981-2010: November mean daily minimum 24.4 C, mean daily maximum 30.3 C, mean total rainfall 192.5 mm, mean number of rain days 16.0. The page defines a rain day as a day with at least 0.1 mm of rain.

[Station: Punta Cana, Dominican Republic] WMO World Weather Information Service, data supplied by Oficina Nacional de Meteorologia (ONAMET), 30-year period 1961-1990: November mean daily minimum 23.2 C, mean daily maximum 29.4 C, mean total rainfall 116.6 mm, mean number of rain days 11.5. The page defines a rain day as a day with at least 1 mm of rain.

[Station: Naxos, Greece (Cyclades), HNMS] Hellenic National Meteorological Service, Climatic Data for selected stations in Greece, Naxos (lon 25.369, lat 37.081, altitude 3 m; the page states 'Data Period: None'): November minimum monthly temperature 13.7 C, monthly mean temperature 16.4 C, maximum monthly temperature 18.8 C, monthly mean precipitation height 52.3 mm, monthly mean precipitation days 8.8, monthly mean humidity 74.1%, prevailing wind direction N, monthly mean wind power 13.2 (chart axis unit: Kt). HNMS does not define a precipitation day on this page. HNMS row labels are 'minimum/maximum monthly temperature', not WMO's 'mean daily minimum/maximum'. Naxos is not Mykonos or Santorini.

WMO World Weather Information Service city pages (all seven checked) carry this remark: 'Please note that the averaging period for climatological information and the definition of "Mean Number of Rain Days" quoted in this web site may be different for different countries. Hence, care should be taken when city climatologies are compared.' Periods in this batch: Milan, Naples, Nice, Port Louis 1971-2000; Lisbon, Punta Cana 1961-1990; Victoria 1981-2010. Rain-day thresholds stated: Nice, Port Louis, Punta Cana at least 1 mm; Lisbon, Victoria at least 0.1 mm; Milan, Naples not stated.

WMO World Weather Information Service pages showed sunset on 24 November 2026 (local time): Milan 4:45 PM, Nice 4:59 PM, Lisbon 5:18 PM; Naples showed sunset 4:38 PM on 25 November 2026. These are single-day values displayed by the site, not climatology.

[New Zealand, one year only (November 2025), not a normal] Earth Sciences New Zealand (formerly NIWA), 'Climate Summary for November 2025' (published 9 December 2025, read live 26 November 2026), headline 'New Zealand's warmest November on record'. 'The nationwide average temperature in November 2025 was 15.9°C. This is 2.2°C above the 1991-2020 November average, making it New Zealand's warmest November on record.' The previous November record (2022) was 15.5°C. 'November began with a week-long settled spell for most of Aotearoa New Zealand, as high pressure remained slow moving nearby: a notable change after a dramatically unsettled October.' La Niña conditions continued through the month.

[New Zealand, one year only (November 2025)] Earth Sciences New Zealand, Climate Summary for November 2025 (read live 26 November 2026): rainfall was well above or above normal for most of Northland, Auckland, Waikato, the Bay of Plenty, Taranaki, southern Marlborough, Fiordland and southwestern Stewart Island; below or well below normal for southeastern Gisborne, Hawke's Bay, Whanganui, Manawatū, Wairarapa, Wellington, most of Canterbury, eastern and central Otago, and eastern and southern Southland. Low pressure systems tapping Coral Sea moisture led to 'several periods of heavy rainfall for the upper and western North Island'.

[New Zealand, one year only (November 2025)] Earth Sciences New Zealand, Climate Summary for November 2025, Further Highlights (read live 26 November 2026): highest temperature 33.0°C at Hastings on 27 November; lowest -2.3°C at Mount Cook Airport on 1 November; highest 1-day rainfall 148 mm at Arthur's Pass Village on 18 November; highest wind gust 161 km/h at South West Cape on 27 November. Of the six main centres, Tauranga was the warmest and sunniest, Hamilton the wettest, and Dunedin the coolest, driest and least sunny.

[Copied from wedding-destinations-march 03-source-pack.part-mr_b fact_103 (originally get-married-in-new-zealand fact_115), same source and date.] As at November 2026, Smartraveller New Zealand (updated 22 July 2026, still current at 17 November 2026, read live 17 November 2026): weather conditions can change quickly and severe weather can leave you stranded, especially in remote areas; monitor MetService forecasts and warnings. On the roads, ice, snow, fog, high winds and roaming animals cause hazards, heavy rain can cause landslides, and mountain and ski-field roads can be narrow, unpaved, without barriers and may need snow chains or a 4WD.

[Fiji, one year only (November 2025), not a normal] Fiji Meteorological Service, Fiji Climate Summary November 2025 (Volume 46, Issue 11, issued 5 December 2025; PDF read live 26 November 2026): 'Typical wet season rainfall was observed across most parts of the country in November. Rainfall ranged from below average to well above average. Most stations recorded wetter than usual conditions.' Of 25 reporting rainfall stations, 8 were well above average, 13 above average, 3 average and 1 below average (Vunisea). Highest monthly total 591.5 mm at Levuka; lowest 84.5 mm at Sigatoka. Comparisons are against the 1991-2020 normal.

[Fiji, one year only (November 2025)] Fiji Meteorological Service, Fiji Climate Summary November 2025 (PDF read live 26 November 2026): 'November marked the start of Fiji's wet and cyclone season and was characterised by warmer temperatures, high humidity, and frequent rain.' Severe thunderstorms on 15 and 16 November brought hail and gusty winds to eastern Viti Levu, and trough activity from 22 to 27 November brought widespread rain and flash flooding, especially in Vanua Levu. A series of troughs caused flash flooding at several low-level crossings in the Central, Western and Northern Divisions, closing crossings and making some areas inaccessible. Warmest day 36.7°C at Momi on 8 November; coolest night 13.5°C at Nadarivatu on 8 November.

[Fiji: Nadi Airport, one year only (November 2025)] Fiji Meteorological Service, Fiji Climate Summary November 2025, Table 2 (PDF, automated text extraction, read live 26 November 2026): Nadi Airport recorded 219.1 mm of rain in November 2025, 173% of its 1991-2020 November average, over 15 rain days (rain day = 0.1 mm or more); average daily maximum 30.4°C and average daily minimum 22.3°C.
facts.conflicts: Figure 2 in the same PDF, as extracted, shows a Nov-25 Nadi Airport value of 19.5 against a long-term 17.6, which does not match Table 2 (219.1 mm, 173%); the chart extraction appears garbled. Treat the Nadi figures as unconfirmed until the PDF is read directly.

facts.claim: [Copied from wedding-destinations-march 03-source-pack.part-mr_b fact_105, same source and date.] As at November 2026, Smartraveller Fiji (updated 19 October 2026, still current at 24 November 2026, read live 25 November 2026): 'November to April is cyclone season, but cyclones may occur at other times.' A tropical cyclone's direction and strength can change quickly; during and after a cyclone flights to and from affected areas can be delayed or suspended and available flights may fill quickly. For cyclone updates check the Fiji Meteorological Service.

[Copied from wedding-destinations-march 03-source-pack.part-mr_b fact_106, same source and date.] As at November 2026, Smartraveller Fiji (updated 19 October 2026, read live 25 November 2026): 'Flooding is common, especially in downtown Nadi and on the Coral Coast.' Floods can cut off road access, including access to the airport; monitor road closures on the Fiji Roads Authority Facebook page.

[Copied from wedding-destinations-march 03-source-pack.part-mr_b fact_107 (originally bali-wedding-venues 03-source-pack), same source and date.] As at November 2026, Smartraveller Indonesia: weather can change quickly during the wet season (usually around October to April; it can differ in Eastern Indonesia). Heavy rains can cause significant flooding in urban areas including Bali, disrupting roads and transport. No temperature or rainfall figures are given.

[Seychelles] Seychelles Meteorological Authority, 'Seychelles Climate Guide', Climate Guide for November (read live 26 November 2026): 'We're approaching the summer in the southern hemisphere, it's getting warmer and the rains set-in. There are still lots of sunshine around as indicated by the number of dry days below. The winds drop significantly and swing to the west. Conditions at sea quite pleasant.' (The 'number of dry days below' table did not render in the read; no November figure is taken from this page.) The same page describes December as 'well into the rain season' and January as the peak of the rainy season.

[Copied from wedding-destinations-march 03-source-pack.part-mr_b fact_110 (originally getting-married-in-seychelles fact_117), same source and date.] As at November 2026, Smartraveller Seychelles (updated 28 October 2026, still current at 17 November 2026, read live 17 November 2026): heavy rain can occur, especially during the monsoon season from November to March, causing flooding and landslides that damage roads and infrastructure; if travelling in the wet season, check with operators whether services are affected.

[Hawaii, statewide] National Weather Service Honolulu, 'Climate of Hawai`i' (read live 26 November 2026): 'For most of Hawaii, there are only two seasons: "summer," between May and October, and "winter," between October and April.' Winter is 'the season of more frequent clouds and rainstorms', as trade winds may be interrupted by fronts, migratory cyclones and Kona storms. Hawaii's warmest months are August and September and its coolest February and March. (The page is a condensed chapter of the 1983 Atlas of Hawaii by Saul Price.)

[Hawaii, statewide] National Weather Service Honolulu, 'Climate of Hawai`i' (read live 26 November 2026): 'Hawaii's heaviest rains are come from winter storms between October and April.' When moist air rises over windward coasts and slopes, clouds and rainfall are much greater; 'Leeward areas, where the air descends, tend to be sunny and dry.' Leeward and dry areas get their rainfall mainly from a few winter storms. The NWS Honolulu page also links a 'Hawaiian Islands 2026-2027 Wet Season Outlook' (not read).

[Copied from wedding-destinations-march 03-source-pack.part-mr_b fact_112 (originally mauritius-wedding fact_111), same source and date.] As at November 2026, Smartraveller Mauritius (read live 17 November 2026): cyclone season in Mauritius is from November to May, but cyclones can occur throughout the year, bringing gale force winds, heavy rain, floods and disruption to power and water. During cyclones the airport may close and flights may be cancelled or delayed, so check travel insurance covers this.

[Mauritius, island-wide] Mauritius Meteorological Services, 'Climate of Mauritius' (read live 26 November 2026): 'The country has two seasons: a warm humid summer extending from November to April and a relatively cool dry winter from June to September. The month of October and May are commonly known as the transition months.' Mean summer temperature is 24.7°C (winter 20.4°C). Long-term mean annual rainfall (1971-2000) is 2010 mm; the wettest months are February and March and the driest October; mean summer rainfall (1971-2000) is 1344 mm, 67% of the annual amount; 'Although there is no marked rainy season, most of the rainfall occurs in summer months.' No November-specific figure is given on this page.

[Copied from wedding-destinations-march 03-source-pack.part-mr_b fact_115, same source and date.] The WMO World Weather Information Service Victoria (Seychelles) page carries the remark: 'Please note that the averaging period for climatological information and the definition of "Mean Number of Rain Days" quoted in this web site may be different for different countries. Hence, care should be taken when city climatologies are compared.'

[Copied from punta-cana-destination-wedding 03-source-pack fact_117, same source and date.] US National Hurricane Center: 'The Atlantic hurricane season runs from June 1 to November 30.' The Atlantic basin includes the Atlantic Ocean, Caribbean Sea and Gulf of America.

[Copied from punta-cana-destination-wedding 03-source-pack fact_118, same source and date.] US National Hurricane Center: tropical cyclone activity sometimes occurs before and after the official June 1 to November 30 season; the peak of the Atlantic hurricane season is September 10, with most activity occurring between mid-August and mid-October.

insider_details.detail: Naples' November average rainfall (152.1 mm, 1971-2000) is the wettest month on its WMO table, so for an Amalfi Coast or Bay of Naples November wedding the covered or indoor alternative should be confirmed in writing at contract stage, not left as a nice-to-have.

Northern autumn light goes early: sunset showed around 4:40 to 5:20 PM local time in Naples, Milan, Nice and Lisbon in late November 2026. Plan ceremony times and photographs backwards from sunset, and put coastal or lake transfers before dark where you can.

Milan's November mean daily maximum is 10.7 C and minimum 3.7 C (city station, 1971-2000). For a northern Italian lakes date, treat outdoor drinks as a short moment, and plan heaters, wraps and a warm room for dinner.

Do not rank Lisbon against Nice, or Victoria against Port Louis, on rain days: Lisbon and Victoria count days with at least 0.1 mm, Nice and Port Louis count at least 1 mm, and the normals periods differ. Quote each place's figure with its own station and period.

Seychelles (Victoria) and Mauritius (Port Louis) show similar November maximums (30.3 C and 30.2 C) but very different published rainfall (192.5 mm against 24.0 mm) on different definitions and periods. For a Seychelles beach ceremony, a sheltered back-up spot on the property is worth agreeing in advance.

Fiji's own met service describes November as the start of the wet and cyclone season, and in November 2025 (one year only) troughs closed low-level crossings in several divisions; with Smartraveller flagging flooding in downtown Nadi and on the Coral Coast, build a buffer day and confirm the resort's wet-weather and transfer plans in writing.

November 2025 was New Zealand's warmest November on record but also brought several heavy-rain periods to the upper and western North Island, so treat one warm year as a single observation and keep a covered option and flexible transfer timings, watching MetService warnings in wedding week.

The Seychelles Meteorological Authority says November is when the rains set in but winds drop and sea conditions are quite pleasant, while Smartraveller places November at the start of the November to March monsoon season, so plan an undercover option on land and confirm boat transfers with operators closer to the date.

In Hawaii November falls in the October to April winter season when the heaviest rains come from winter storms, and leeward areas tend to be sunnier and drier, so ask whether a venue sits on the leeward or windward side.
November opens Mauritius's warm humid summer and Smartraveller's November to May cyclone season, so check that travel insurance covers cyclone disruption to flights.

The official Atlantic hurricane season ends on 30 November, and the US National Hurricane Center notes activity sometimes occurs outside the season, so couples on Caribbean dates near the end of November should still hold cancellation-friendly travel insurance.
